Tips

  • Hold Reverse and drag the wheel with your other thumb. Reversing flips the response: steer opposite to the way you want the trailer's rear to go.
  • Small, early corrections. Once the hitch angle passes about 40°, let go and pull forward to straighten.
  • Each pull-up (forward after reversing) costs a star at the top rating.

Simplified model: no tyre slip, one trailer axle point. It shows how a rig behaves, not a specific real vehicle.
